scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/dirty-30 run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen && git diff --exit-code -- lib/api-client-react/src/generated lib/api-zod/src/generated && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
